notes:
First release of Spec Studio.

- Run a spec through five stages with one Claude session: Spec, Plan, Build, Check and Merge.
- Autopilot takes a description to reviewed draft PRs with one approval at the end. Guided mode asks at each gate.
- Loop mode: one ask, one change, its proof.
- The self review runs parallel finders and a 2-of-3 verifier vote on each PR.
- A shell panel beside each session, themes, and a Settings window.
- The remote relay (self-hosted, in spec-studio-app/relay) lets Claude AI read specs and send messages while the Mac is offline.
